units.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net reads and writes MSG files using the MAPI message format. It converts EML messages to MSG format and writes them to streams or files. It also reads structured storage files and exposes their internal layout for inspection.

It reads and writes Outlook MSG files at the high-level MapiMessage layer, allowing programmatic creation, editing, and persistence of complete email messages in memory, including setting sender and recipient details and saving to a stream or file.

It opens and traverses Compound File Binary containers from a file, stream, or byte array, and builds such containers programmatically using CfbDocument, CfbStorage, and CfbStream, then serializes them to bytes or a file.

It converts between MSG and EML formats natively, parsing standard RFC 5322 and MIME .eml files directly into MapiMessage objects and serializing MapiMessage back to MIME without requiring an external parser.

It attaches recipients and files to messages using AddRecipient and AddAttachment, including nested embedded messages via AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment, as demonstrated by creating a message, adding a recipient, attaching a file from a stream, and saving the result.
It sets and reads arbitrary MAPI properties on messages using SetProperty and GetPropertyValue, beyond the strongly typed properties exposed directly by MapiMessage.
It inspects parsing problems on loaded messages through the read-only ValidationIssues list, populated when strict parsing encounters structural anomalies.
This example creates a new MSG file with a subject, body, sender, recipient, and attachment using Aspose.Email.Foss version 26.7.0 for net8.0.

Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net is the entry point for working with email formats in .NET, providing high-level APIs for message creation and conversion. It is built on lower-level CFB and MSG storage APIs that give direct access to the underlying file structures.

The MapiMessage class serves as the primary high-level entry point for creating, editing, and converting messages, supporting operations such as adding recipients and attachments, and saving to MSG or EML formats.

It adds broader format and protocol coverage: direct IMAP/SMTP/POP3 mail-server connectivity, TNEF (winmail.dat) support, calendar and appointment APIs, and classic .NET Framework support alongside this edition's MSG, CFB, and EML processing.

CfbConstants class defines constants used in Compound File Binary structures, including ByteOrderLittleEndian for little-endian encoding, MAXREGSECT and MAXREGSID for maximum sector and stream identifiers, MiniStreamCutoffSize for the largest mini-stream size, NOSTREAM, RootEntryName, and RootStreamId.

CfbDocument class represents a Compound File Binary document and provides constructors, factory methods FromFile, FromReader, and FromStream, and properties MajorVersion, MinorVersion, Root, and TransactionSignatureNumber.
CfbException class is the exception type used for errors in Compound File Binary processing and exposes a constructor CfbException.
CfbNode class holds metadata for a Compound File Binary node and exposes properties Clsid, CreationTime, ModifiedTime, Name, and StateBits.

CfbReader class reads Compound File Binary files and exposes constructors CfbReader, factory methods FromFile and FromStream, read-only properties Difat, DirectoryEntries, DirectoryEntryCount, Fat, FileSize, MajorVersion, MiniFat, MiniSectorSize, MiniStream, SectorSize, and methods Dispose, FindChildByName, GetEntry, GetStreamData, IterChildren, IterStorages, IterStreams, IterTree, and ResolvePath; CfbReader.CfbReader throws ArgumentNullException conditionally, and GetEntry and GetStreamData throw CfbException conditionally.

CfbStorage class represents a storage node in a Compound File Binary and exposes a constructor CfbStorage, methods AddStorage and AddStream, and properties Children, Clsid, CreationTime, ModifiedTime, and Name.
CfbStream class represents a stream node in a Compound File Binary and exposes a constructor CfbStream and properties Clsid, CreationTime, Data, ModifiedTime, Name, and StateBits.
CfbWriter class writes Compound File Binary files and exposes methods ToBytes and WriteFile.
DirectoryEntry class provides methods IsRoot, IsStorage, and IsStream to determine the type of a Compound File Binary directory entry.
DirectoryEntryNameComparer class provides a Compare method to compare directory entry names.
Header class holds the header information of a Compound File Binary and exposes read-only properties MiniSectorSize and SectorSize.

MapiAttachment class represents a MAPI attachment and exposes properties ContentId, Data, EmbeddedMessage, Filename, IsEmbeddedMessage, and IsStorageAttachment, and factory methods FromBytes and FromStream.

MapiMessage class represents a MAPI message and exposes methods AddAttachment, AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment, and AddRecipient, constants AttachMethodByValue, AttachMethodEmbedded, and AttachMethodStorage, and properties Attachments and Body.
MapiProperty class represents a MAPI property and exposes a constructor MapiProperty, and properties Flags, PropertyId, PropertyTag, PropertyType, and Value.
MapiPropertyCollection class manages a collection of MAPI properties and exposes methods Add, Get, IterProperties, Remove, and Set.
MapiRecipient class represents a MAPI recipient and exposes properties AddressType, DisplayName, EmailAddress, RecipientType, and a read-only property Properties.

MsgConstants class defines constants used in MSG files, including AttachmentStoragePrefix, EmbeddedMessageStorageName, MaxAttachmentStorages, MaxRecipientStorages, NamedPropertyMappingStorageName, PROPATTR_MANDATORY, PROPATTR_READABLE, and PROPATTR_WRITABLE.

MsgDocument class represents an MSG file as a Compound File Binary document and exposes a constructor MsgDocument, factory methods FromFile and FromStream, properties MajorVersion, MinorVersion, Root, and Strict, and method ToCfbDocument; MsgDocument.MsgDocument throws ArgumentNullException conditionally.
MsgException class is the exception type used for errors in MSG processing and exposes a constructor MsgException.
MsgReader class reads MSG files and exposes factory methods FromFile and FromStream, method Dispose, and a read-only property ValidationIssues.

MsgStorage class represents a storage node in an MSG file and exposes a constructor MsgStorage, methods AddStorage, AddStream, FindStorage, and FindStream, and properties Clsid, CreationTime, ModifiedTime; MsgStorage.MsgStorage throws ArgumentNullException conditionally.
MsgStorageRole enum lists the values Attachment, CustomAttachment, EmbeddedMessage, Generic, Message, NamedPropertyMapping, and Recipient to identify the role of a storage node in an MSG file.

MsgStream class represents a stream node in an MSG file and exposes a constructor MsgStream and properties Clsid, CreationTime, Data, ModifiedTime, Name, and StateBits; MsgStream.MsgStream throws ArgumentNullException conditionally.
MsgWriter class writes MSG files and exposes methods ToBytes and WriteFile.
